card.title: PlayStation 5 Pro No Power

claims.statement: PS5 Pro no power: check 12 V, then 5 V at the coil, then southbridge PMIC outputs (1.15 V and 3.3 V), then all F-numbered fuses, then shorts behind the southbridge; finally the southbridge (CXD90069GG, same as Slim) itself.
With the PSU removed, the board's 12 V input should read about 0.400–0.500 in diode mode; 0.000 is a short.
Missing 1.15 V/3.3 V with 5 V input present means the PMIC; a short on its 5 V input opens fuse F7002.

procedure: Check 5 V at the coil; look for shorted caps beside it.
Check shorts behind southbridge; replace CXD90069GG.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
